_comment: Optional external validators, loaded when RIP_MCP_CONFIG points at a copy of this file.
Nothing here is enabled by default. Each entry sends resume text to a third-party service only when
allow_resume_data is true AND RIP_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_DATA_SHARING=true (local_only tools are exempt).
HireLayer's MCP server was verified to exist (official, MIT, npm hirelayer-mcp, maintained) but has NOT
been connected or tested from this project: it needs your own API key. Run `tools/list` against it and
confirm the argument names of score_resumes before setting enabled=true. By default HireLayer stores
parsed resumes in your account (Paris, France); pass do_not_store_data if you enable it.

servers.name: hirelayer
servers.notes: Score is 0-1 from HireLayer's own model, shown as-is; never mixed into this tool's scores.

servers.name: local-test-parser
servers.notes: Test fixture only (runs on this machine). Useful to see the adapter flow end to end.
